title: 121. Word Ladder

examples.explanation: One shortest sequence is hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog.
The end word is not in the list.

hints: Words are graph nodes; two words share an edge when they differ in exactly one position.
Generate neighbors by replacing each character with every lowercase letter instead of comparing every pair of words.
Bidirectional BFS from beginWord and endWord can substantially reduce the explored search space.
